CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing condition linked to content is present.

COD.rationale: The report names a specific content (red coordinate set), shows its organizational pattern, and provides a separate origin/status field for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to a content's organization/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content descriptions (red/blue coordinate sets) identify content and attribute.

D.rationale: Separate origin/status fields are provided alongside content listings, distinguishing content identity from its source/status.

O.rationale: The report specifies how content is presented (grid orientation and explicit coordinate groupings), indicating organization/presentation/access.
